name: nerva
description: Nerva: the operating system for AI-powered companies.

scripts.setup: npm run api:setup && npm run web:install
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run api:migrate
scripts.lint: npm run api:lint && npm run web:lint && npm run web:format:check
scripts.typecheck: npm run api:typecheck && npm run web:typecheck
scripts.test: npm run api:test && npm run web:test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run web:build
